title: The Super-Fast Logistics of Delivering Blood By Drone
summary: A Wendover Productions documentary-style video on how Zipline delivers blood and medical supplies by drone in Rwanda. It covers the catapult launch, parachute drop and the logistics behind it.
why: Offered as a clear, well-made look at a real, working drone-delivery system, often in answer to skepticism about delivery drones.

quote.text: Wendover Productions did a great video detailing this a few years back.
